safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes Clenil is used daily but does not capture the Gold dose of 2 puffs twice daily (meds-002 explicitly says dose/frequency not clearly confirmed).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the patient’s baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs twice daily) reduces clarity on current controller therapy and makes it harder to assess severity/control and to safely recommend an appropriate step-up during an exacerbation. This can lead to suboptimal or incorrect inhaled steroid adjustments and delayed symptom control.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the patient has ever required antibiotics or (especially) systemic steroids for asthma is a marker of historical exacerbation severity and risk; omitting a clear lifetime “never” can impair risk stratification and escalation planning. However, it is unlikely on its own to directly cause harm without additional downstream mismanagement.
